metadata.title: What If An Heir or Beneficary is Missing?  How to Find a Missing Heir?
metadata.author: Win-Win Realtors TV
metadata.shortDescription:
What If an heir or beneficiary is missing?  How to find a missing heir?  The court appointed executor or administrator is reponsible for identifying and locating any missing heir or beneficiary of a deceased resident of the state of California.  It is also the reponsibility of the successor trustee of a trust to locate any missing beneficiaries.   The California probate code mandates that the personal representative must use "Due Diligence" to identify and locate any missing heir of a deceased Califoria resident.
